title: Brochettes de soja (Soy Skewers)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Soy soaked 12 hours, ground and filtered into soy milk, boiled, curdled with tamarind juice added gradually, pressed 20 minutes, cubed, skewered with onion and fried.
longDesc: p. 39 of the October 2023 recipe book: 300 g soy, ½ litre tamarind juice, 4 onions and ½ litre of water, plus green condiments, bell pepper, garlic, salt, refined oil and skewers. The soy is soaked 12 hours (the page prints prep 1 hour, cook 1 hour), crushed and winnowed, ground wet and filtered; the soy milk is boiled; tamarind juice is added gradually and ‘causes the proteins to precipitate into flakes’; filtered to a curd; seasoned; pressed 20 minutes; cut in cubes, skewered with onion and fried. This is not a fermentation — tamarind acts as the coagulant. Seasoning amounts and the frying time are not printed.
ingredients: Green condiments, bell pepper, garlic, salt — quantities not printed
Refined oil for frying — quantity not printed
steps: Soak the soy 12 hours. Crush and winnow.
Grind wet and filter. Boil the soy milk.
Add the tamarind juice gradually until the proteins precipitate into flakes.
Filter to a curd and season.
Skewer the cubes with onion and fry.
chefTips: The printed cue is that the proteins ‘precipitate into flakes’ when the tamarind juice goes in.
The frying time is not printed.
commonMistakes: Adding the tamarind juice all at once.
Frying at too high a heat so the cubes burn.
healthBenefits: Soy curd is high in plant protein.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Brochettes de soja’ (p. 39). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 6 is a placeholder; printed prep 1 h and cook 1 h plus the 12-hour soak (prep 720 includes the soak). TWO-PASS.
ABSENT: seasoning amounts; frying time and temperature.
